Follow that reference: distinctly long narrow sculpted face, high angular cheekbones, lean sharp jaw, fine straight nose, pale blue eyes, full sculpted lips, pale skin; recognizable Jamie Campbell Bower features, not Jack Gleeson and not the rounder face of earlier generated portraits. Blond medium-length swept-back tousled hair, side strands over ears and nape, NOT a short straight fringe. Keep elegant aloof aristocratic expression and slightly raised chin. Gold branching antler crown fully visible with top margin, high-collared plum-purple and gold floral brocade, deep purple velvet drape over one shoulder, match user's reference clothing closely.
